'''2007 Maryland State Championship Steve Harpster LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' STEVEN HARPSTER
* '''Deck name:''' FUCK YO BD
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
